name: frontend-rooting-from-repo-base
body:
Every frontend's package/module identity is derived from the repository-relative base, rather than from the basename of the checkout directory it runs in, and each source file is emitted under one module identity. Concretely: a TS repo's root module identity is independent of the checkout name, so a checkout-basename module (`ts.cosanima-1.0.0` or `ts.fix-module-identity`) has zero admissibility even when build outputs live outside the named packages; and a file inside a named workspace package is emitted once, under that package.

Acceptance criteria:
- A scan of a worktree contains only modules whose names are independent of the worktree/checkout directory basename.
- Each source file appears under exactly one module identity.
- A file shared by two worktrees has the same module identity in both graphs.
